description: This file implements the MonkeySourceNetwork class, which provides a network-based event source for the Android Monkey testing tool. It receives commands over a network socket, parses them into MonkeyEvents, and manages command execution and deferred responses for automated UI testing.

classes.name: MonkeyCommandReturn
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of executing a Monkey command, including success status and optional message.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.MonkeyCommand
classes.description: Interface for Monkey commands, requiring translation of command lines into MonkeyEvents.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.FlipCommand
classes.description: Simulates opening or closing the keyboard.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.TouchCommand
classes.description: Simulates touch events at specified screen coordinates.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.KeyCommand
classes.description: Sends key press events based on key codes or names.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.SleepCommand
classes.description: Inserts a delay or sleep in the event sequence.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.TypeCommand
classes.description: Generates key events to type a string.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.TapCommand
classes.description: Simulates a tap (touch down and up) at x,y.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.PressCommand
classes.description: Simulates pressing (down and up) a specific key.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.DeferReturnCommand
classes.description: Defers command execution until a specific event occurs or timeout.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork.CommandQueueImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a command queue to hold pending events.

classes.name: DeferredReturn
classes.description: Holds deferred command results, waiting for specific events or timeouts.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Forces the device to wake up using IPowerManager.

methods.name: replaceQuotedChars
methods.description: Replaces escaped quotes within input string.

methods.name: commandLineSplit
methods.description: Splits command line into tokens, respecting quoted strings.

methods.name: translateCommand
methods.description: Parses command line and dispatches to appropriate command translation.

methods.name: handleReturn
methods.description: Handles the result of command translation, sending response over network.
